api/src/services/solutions/__init__.py.name: Solution packaging
api/src/services/solutions/__init__.py.description: Groups the code that packs workflows, apps, forms and tables into one installable package.

api/src/services/solutions/app_build.py.name: App builds
api/src/services/solutions/app_build.py.description: Builds a Solution's custom app screens on the server and publishes them ready to open.

api/src/services/solutions/authorization.name: Solution authority checks
api/src/services/solutions/authorization.description: Confirms the person asking really is the Solution's original owner before any change is allowed.

api/src/services/solutions/capture.py.name: Gathering a Solution
api/src/services/solutions/capture.py.description: Collects loose workflows, apps, forms and tables into a Solution so they can be shipped together.

api/src/services/solutions/dependency_wa.name: Package contents check
api/src/services/solutions/dependency_wa.description: Works out everything a chosen set of items needs so the package is complete and nothing is left behind.

api/src/services/solutions/deploy_job_st.name: Deploy input storage
api/src/services/solutions/deploy_job_st.description: Holds an uploaded package safely until the background deploy is ready to read it.

api/src/services/solutions/deploy.py.name: Solution deploy
api/src/services/solutions/deploy.py.description: Installs or replaces a Solution's contents in one step so the destination always matches the package.

api/src/services/solutions/export_jobs.p.name: Backup exports
api/src/services/solutions/export_jobs.p.description: Prepares downloadable backups in the background, with choices for secrets, sample data and passwords.

api/src/services/solutions/export.py.name: Backup packages
api/src/services/solutions/export.py.description: Builds the downloadable package of a Solution's code, settings and sample data.

api/src/services/solutions/file_location.name: Solution file locations
api/src/services/solutions/file_location.description: Remembers where each Solution's runtime files live so links and access rules stay correct after a deploy.

api/src/services/solutions/file_payloads.name: Encrypted backup contents
api/src/services/solutions/file_payloads.description: Encrypts large file contents inside a backup so sensitive material is unreadable without the password.

api/src/services/solutions/git_sync.py.name: Solution auto-pull
api/src/services/solutions/git_sync.py.description: Pulls a Solution's GitHub repository and installs the newest version without manual steps.

api/src/services/solutions/guard.py.name: Solution item protection
api/src/services/solutions/guard.py.description: Stops anyone editing items a Solution owns so an upgrade cannot silently wipe their changes.

api/src/services/solutions/integration_s.name: Connection placeholders
api/src/services/solutions/integration_s.description: Creates the shared connection entries a Solution needs without overwriting connections already in use.

api/src/services/solutions/integration_t.name: Connection skeleton
api/src/services/solutions/integration_t.description: Makes a blank, secret-free copy of a connection so a Solution can declare what it needs.

api/src/services/solutions/pending.py.name: Setup blockers
api/src/services/solutions/pending.py.description: Lists items still waiting to be pulled in that would block a deploy.

api/src/services/solutions/ref_rewriter..name: Renamed workflow links
api/src/services/solutions/ref_rewriter..description: Updates every reference to a renamed workflow so forms and code keep working.

api/src/services/solutions/ref_scanner.p.name: Reference finder
api/src/services/solutions/ref_scanner.p.description: Reads code to find which tables, settings, workflows and connections it uses.

api/src/services/solutions/secrets_blob..name: Encrypted secrets pack
api/src/services/solutions/secrets_blob..description: Packs a Solution's passwords, settings and sample records into one encrypted file for backup.

api/src/services/solutions/setup_status..name: Setup checklist
api/src/services/solutions/setup_status..description: Works out what still needs doing after an install, such as connections and settings, and shows it.

api/src/services/solutions/source_artifa.name: Solution source copy
api/src/services/solutions/source_artifa.description: Keeps a copy of a deployed Solution's source so its app screens can be rebuilt later.

api/src/services/solutions/storage.py.name: Solution file storage
api/src/services/solutions/storage.py.description: Keeps each Solution's files in their own folder in cloud storage so installs never mix.

api/src/services/solutions/update_check..name: Update detection
api/src/services/solutions/update_check..description: Checks a git-connected Solution for a newer published version and flags it as ready to update.

api/src/services/solutions/vendoring.py.name: Bundled dependencies
api/src/services/solutions/vendoring.py.description: Points to the shared helpers that make a Solution's outside code libraries travel with it.

api/src/services/solutions/workspace_bun.name: Apply reviewed package
api/src/services/solutions/workspace_bun.description: Applies a reviewed package to the workspace, settling each clash exactly the way the reviewer chose.

api/src/services/solutions/workspace_bun.name: Package review plan
api/src/services/solutions/workspace_bun.description: Turns an uploaded package into a clear list of what will be added or changed before anything happens.

api/src/services/solutions/workspace_bun.name: Package preview storage
api/src/services/solutions/workspace_bun.description: Holds uploaded packages while they are being reviewed and clears out previews that have expired.

api/src/services/solutions/write_lock.py.name: One deploy at a time
api/src/services/solutions/write_lock.py.description: Stops two deploys of the same Solution running at once so its contents cannot be half-written.

api/src/services/solutions/zip_install.p.name: Package install
api/src/services/solutions/zip_install.p.description: Installs a Solution from an uploaded file, previewing what it would do and then applying it safely.
